extraction.Name: Timothy Giago
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee and did not realize what he was doing when he signed the receipt for it, but that he did sign the receipt and send it to the Office and received the patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it to the Ruddy Land. Co. Gordon, Nebr, for $200.00
extraction.Buyer: Ruddy Land. Co. Gordon, Nebr, for $200.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes on his land, and was about to lose it so he sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: does common labor for a living, averaging $40.00 per month
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in fair health; has a wife and three children depending on him for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since he was granted a patent in fee; deponent states he does not think $200.00 was a fair price for the land but it was the best he could do; has no land, no home and nothing; document notarized November 28, 1928 in Shannon County, State of South Dakota | TASK 3 BULK TRIBE INFERENCE 2026-04-29: Tribe field set to 'Pine Ridge' based on directory provenance (record is filed in pine_ridge_*/extractions/, which corresponds to the NARA RG 75 Pine Ridge Vol 1, Vol 2, and Vol 3 bound volumes of Circular 2464 responses). 67 such records were originally 'not stated'; 6 received BLM-confirmed substantive patches in the same transaction; the remaining 61 (this record's batch) are inferred from directory and geographic/naming evidence. Inference is rebuttable — any record can be re-evaluated via BLM cross-reference if its Pine Ridge affiliation is questioned.
